summary: Engadget rounds up 26 deals from Amazon's October Prime Big Deal Days that were still live after the sale officially ended on Wednesday. Amazon's own devices mostly returned to full price, while products from Google, Samsung, Anker and others kept their Prime Day lows. The list covers smartwatches, laptops, audio gear, TVs, smart home devices and storage, with prices and reasons each is worth buying.
one_line: Engadget lists the best Amazon October Prime Day deals still available after the sale ended, from Samsung, Google, Sony, Apple, Anker and more.
key_facts: Amazon's October Prime Day sale officially ended on Wednesday, but some deals remained live heading into the weekend.
Amazon returned most of its own devices, like Echos and Kindles, to full price, while Google, Samsung and Anker products kept their Prime Day lows.
The Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 is $269, the lowest price since its release a few months earlier, and the Classic version brings back the spinning bezel.
The 15-inch Apple MacBook Air M2 is $1,049 (down from $1,260) with 8GB of RAM and a 256GB SSD; Engadget gave it a review score of 96.
The 512GB, 8GB RAM MacBook Air 15-inch is $1,249, and the 13.6-inch MacBook Air is $899 at Best Buy, $200 off list.
Sony's WF-1000XM5 wireless earbuds are $278, a $22 discount and their best price yet; Engadget calls them the best wireless earbuds on the market.
The previous-generation Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K is $23 and supports Dolby Vision HDR and Dolby Atmos.
The Anker Soundcore Motion + speaker drops from a $100 MSRP to $70 with an on-page coupon, a 30 percent all-time low.
The Samsung Smart Monitor M8 (32-inch, 2023 version) is $500, versus a regular $600 price, the lowest seen.
The Beats Studio Pro headphones are $180, a $170 discount; Engadget gave them a review score of 81.
The Google Nest Wi-Fi Pro 6E three-pack is $300, within a dollar of its lowest Amazon price.
The Hisense U6K is $400 (55-inch) and $548 (65-inch), matching all-time lows, while the U8K is $748 (55-inch) and $998 (65-inch).
The iRobot Roomba 694 is $199, $20 above its lowest price, and the Samsung Pro Plus microSD card is $20.
